Human-centred design projects

Marine conservation & behaviour change

Blue Horizon

AR Marine Conservation App for Children · UI/UX, AR Interaction Design

Mobile AR that lets kids aged 6–12 scan drift bottles on the beach, watch a sea animal's entanglement with plastic, then complete a real-world cleanup task for a badge — turning abstract statistics into an emotional, actionable moment.

Azure

Social Platform for Cleanup Volunteers · UX Research, Product Design

A "message in a bottle" social mechanic that turns one-time beach cleaners into a recurring community — built on the Fogg Behavior Model, using random social surprise and recognition to sustain motivation over time.

Marine Gachapon

Recycling Incentive System · Service Design, Hardware Concept

A beach-deployed vending machine that trades plastic waste for a 3D-printed souvenir — using gachapon-style random reward to make recycling feel like play rather than a chore, no app required.

Each project follows a full human-centred process — research, empathy mapping, journey mapping, low- and high-fidelity prototyping, usability testing and technical feasibility. Full case studies available on request.

Designed, built and optimized a series of intricate 3D scene models for a promotional short film, translating concept environments into fully realized, animation-ready assets. Hand-crafted texture maps for every surface and worked directly with the animation team to integrate models so they held up under motion and lighting.

About

I design digital and physical experiences that motivate people to take action for the environment. My approach combines user research (interviews, observation, surveys), rapid prototyping (paper, Figma, cardboard) and technical feasibility (AR, 3D, basic hardware).

I'm a CG Animation graduate from Istituto Europeo di Design in Rome, currently pursuing an MSc in Technology & Design on the Human-Centred Design track at SUTD Singapore — bridging 3D craft with user-centred thinking.

My graduation project, made in collaboration with Rome Film and Television City, took me through the full 3D pipeline: modeling, texturing, and integrating assets into a finished animated sequence. I've since taught art to students aged 6–12 at Tree Art Singapore, sharpening how I break down technique for others.

Fluent in English and Italian, native in Chinese.
